summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release on monthly new residential construction for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 3a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates for new privately-owned housing units started broken down by region (South, Northeast, Midwest, West) for periods from January 2022 through August 2022. This document supplies the specific regional start figures required to compare South housing starts against the combined total of other regions for August 2022, which is the first month of the requested 2022/08 to 2025/05 timeframe. While this release provides the primary data for August 2022, the values are marked preliminary ("p"), and the report does not contain data for any months after August 2022, limiting its coverage to the initial segment of the task window.
